definitions.explanation: Paid items, currency, or upgrades bought from within a smartphone game or app after the initial install. Almost always appears as part of the longer phrase アプリ{内課金|ないかきん}.

examples.japanese: {内課金|ないかきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦アイテム→アイテム：07813_aitemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an item via in-app purchase.

examples.japanese: ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧{内課金|ないかきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧3000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I spend 3,000 yen a month on in-app purchases.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{勝手|かって}に{内課金|ないかきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧なことになった。
examples.english: My child made in-app purchases without permission and the bill turned into a disaster.

notes:
Clipped from ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧{内課金|ないかきん} (⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ ('inside') + ⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧ ('billing/charging')). Refers especially to game purchases of virtual currency, gacha pulls, or in-game items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧{内課金|ないかきん}: in-app purchase (full phrase)
- {内課金|ないかきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦アイテム→アイテム：07813_aitemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy an item via in-app purchase
- {内課金|ないかきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to set a limit on in-app purchases

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧: paid use; topping up — broader; covers any in-app spending
- ガチャ: gacha — random-draw type of in-app purchase
- ⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: free-to-play — the business model that relies on in-app purchases
